I created `docs/policies/wire-format.md`. It says no decision on the wire serialisation format is currently recorded for this project.

I found nothing to base a decision on:
- **Repo:** `docs/doc.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` only describe which formats Gin can render (JSON, XML, YAML, TOML, ProtoBuf, MsgPack) and which build tags switch them off. None of it chooses one as the project's wire format.
- **Memory:** two searches of the claude-mem prompts turned up nothing on wire format. The hits were unrelated prompts about licences, TLS and versioning.

If a decision does exist somewhere I couldn't see, tell me what it is and I'll update the file.

Also, the claude.ai Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors need authorising in your claude.ai connector settings. I couldn't use them in this non-interactive session, and they weren't needed here.
